name: Blockade Breaker
_: Region 1's boss (owner decision H, 2026-10-04): the layered fortress Blockade Breaker of docs/boss-concepts.md, style 1. Two layers: the armour plates ARE the hull's lower face (layer 1, rows 3-7); four pulse cannons and the emitter slot sit recessed behind them in the deep layer (rows 1-3). gun-2 sits in an open bay and fires from the first frame; the others open fire once their plates fall. The emitter slot (slot 1) is enabled on levels 1-4 (decision 8) and fires its laser once plate-d falls (S4b, owner decisions of 2026-10-06). The boss falls with its last weapon; armour left standing is not required. Placeholder art drawn by the agent (decision G); the owner retouches the PNGs. A destroyed module disappears (owner decision L): its top cavityRows rows, inside the hull, become a plain cavity, the rows below it band background - every plate hangs below the hull (0), the cannons and the emitter sit inside it. docs/level-authoring.md, 'The boss', is the format; plan §5.15 the design. Hit points: Q-B3's start values adjusted for the 45-60 s MEDIUM target (decision I) - plates by size 6 / 8 / 10, cannons 14 (plan §5.15: the model's 12 gave a MEASURED 42.8-s MEDIUM fight; 14 is the next step, plan §5.15.7); scores packed BCD.
_seeThrough: Owner decisions M and O (plan §5.16): the only see-through hull art is the girders' stubs one row under the hull line; every other hull cell stops a shot. Decision O (supersedes M1): no hull art below any weapon - the hull's lower strip is cut under gun-1 and the emitter and beside gun-2's and gun-4's bases, gun-4's row-4 pieces under it removed; every weapon hangs in its own recess. Decision N: the open bay is columns 25-29; gun-3 behind plate-e alone; the cowl plates removed (out of reach).

palette._: COLPF0 light steel (the plates' face), COLPF1 mid grey (bevels, trim), COLPF2 amber (cannons, lights, damage glow, sparks, flames), COLPF3 dark burgundy (the hull's bulk). flashLuma: the one-frame band flash adds this to each luminance; every colour stays inside its hue (+4 at most to $0E).

motion._: The band drifts one colour clock every framesPerColourClock frames across travelColourClocks and back (plan §5.2): the window shows band columns 0-55 over the travel, so both engine ends come into view in turn; the win shakes it by HSCROL jitter (Q-S5).

chain._: The win: blasts along every module, the surviving armour included (§5.13.2 item 10).

fire._: One countdown (§5.13.2 item 6): the next armed cannon fires when it reaches 0 and the countdown restarts from that cannon's reload (EASY +1/2, HARD -1/4), never under this cooldown. gun-2's slower reload opens the fight; the faster cannons behind the plates raise the rate as they are exposed.

capped._: An emitter slot the level's laser tier does not enable (decision 8: 1 / 2 / 4 slots on levels 1-4 / 5-8 / 9-12) becomes armour with the capped plate (extras.png) and these hit points.

laser._: S4b (owner decisions Q3, Q11, 2026-10-06): an emitter's laser fires for beamFrames after its warning (the emitter's bottom cell heats, the line pulses, a rising tone on channel 3). S4b.1 (owner decision D3): the warning and the reload are the level's, per difficulty (bossDef laserWarning, laserReload); an emitter is never in the pulse rotation and carries no reload (D1). Placeholder; M8 tunes it.

nozzles._: The engine nozzles at both ends (decision K): the cells that show the left and the right nozzle glyph; their three phases (extras.png) cycle every framesPerPhase frames and go dark on the win's first blast.

modules._: The emitter (owner decisions of 2026-10-06, S4b.3 and the final phase): art A, a lens projector - the lens core in its bottom row's two middle cells, where the beam (M1 / M2, $46) leaves it; rows 1-3, its bottom level with gun-2's and gun-4's, the added row repeating the housing row; the strip beside its base cut (decision O); a destroyed emitter leaves the cavity in all three rows, as the turrets do. Every plate shares one cracked and one broken look, to make room in the charset.
modules.name: emitter

_decisionN: Owner decision N (plan §5.16.7): the open bay is columns 25-29 - gun-2 (26-28) with one clear column each side; gun-1 moved to 22-24 so plate-c (21-24) still covers all of it; plate-b 17-20, plate-d 30-34. The cowl plates under the engine housings are removed: a player shot starts at the fighter's centre (HPOS 56 at the left-most), so their columns were in reach at 8-20 of the band's 64 positions.
